detail.longDescription:
Scan QR codes, read barcodes, and create your own QR codes easily.

🟧 MAIN FEATURES:
✔ Scan QR codes and barcodes instantly
✔ Create your own QR codes
✔ Fast and accurate results
✔ Scan history tracking
✔ Save and share codes easily

The app enables you to scan QR codes, barcodes, passports, and ID cards in just seconds. You can quickly access links, product details, contact information, or connect to WiFi networks. You can also generate custom QR codes for websites, text, or business use, and save your history for later access.

🔸QR CODE & BARCODE SCANNER
Scan any code using your camera and instantly view the result, including links, products, or contact details.
🔸FAST PASSPORT / ID CARD SCANNER
Easily scan and extract important information from documents.
🔸FAST & ACCURATE RESULTS
Enjoy quick scanning with reliable results every time.
🔸QR CODE GENERATOR
Create custom codes for WiFi, websites, contacts, or text in just a few seconds.
🔸SCAN HISTORY
Access your previous scans anytime and reuse them when needed.
🔸SAVE & SHARE CODES
Store codes on your device or share them instantly with others.

❓WHY USE QR CODE READER APP?
✅ Scan products, tickets, and websites
✅ Read barcodes while shopping
✅ Create and share codes easily
✅ Save time with fast scanning

👉 Try it now and make scanning faster and easier than ever.

🧡 Thank you for using our app. We hope it helps you scan and create codes quickly and conveniently. If you enjoy it, please rate us and share your feedback.
